title: implement-backend-feature input
description: Input contract for the implement-backend-feature Generate stage. Validated by the workflow engine before the stage is invoked. Failure to validate halts the workflow before LLM tokens are spent.

design_document.description: Approved markdown design document produced by an earlier design stage. Must declare L1 invariant, L2 contract + data owner, L3 transaction scope + idempotency strategy + observability plan, L4 file/package sketch. Ambiguities cause the Generate stage to loop_back.

target_package.description: Existing Go package path relative to the module root (e.g., internal/loan/disbursement). Missing package signals loop_back.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4. Same key with same other inputs MUST produce the same output bytes.

convention_overrides.description: Repo-specific overrides discovered by an upstream stage that should take precedence over references/go-conventions.md.

test_coverage_target.description: Per-file coverage target enforced at step 5. Coverage below target signals loop_back (feature over-scoped for one Generate).
